edits.why: Redesign Wardrobe & Vanity UI to match the original visual closet/store layout with a live 2D avatar preview doll at the top, slot icons, facial feature selectors, Reset / Test / Save & Checkout buttons, and a visual grid of illustrated clothing items.

Replace the plain text-card World Map modal with an illustrated 2-level World & Region Map featuring geographical regions, dashed-line street connections, circular street nodes, and a street node popover with 'Teleport here (-10e)', 'Create Link for Chat', and 'Set as destination'.

Prevent duplicate street transitions while loading or immediately upon arrival, populate the framed street preview and 'Home to:' list on the loading screen, and show the top-left first-visit XP notification toast.
Wire up the new World globe button to open the World & Region Map modal.
Trigger boundary transition cleanly as the player walks past the wooden signpost (x < 95 or x > width - 95) and respect transition lock & arrival cooldown so street_change never loops.
Render multi-board directional wooden signposts with arrows and adjacent street names at both left and right street boundaries.
Upgrade 2D cartoon avatar rendering with large heads, ears, eyes with highlights, nose, mouth, hair, and layered clothing (coats/capes, dresses, skirts, mounts, masks, and top hats).

notes: Fixed all 8 failing rules: upgraded Wardrobe/Vanity UI with live 2D doll preview, equipment slots, and illustrated clothing grid; added customizable facial features and layered clothing on avatars; added Globe World button and 2-level graphical World/Region map with dashed street lines, circular nodes, and node popover; fixed infinite street_change boundary loop and upgraded signpost & loading screen UI; added top-left first-visit XP toast; added Butler Roy's 10-option menu, 'Thanks!' speech bubble, and 'Roy' IM tab; and implemented the 5-option Magic Rock menu and 6-theme Vorn Road preview & 190i confirmation flow.
